title: Greece Caught Between Fiscal Optimism and a Deepening Cost-of-Living Squeeze · 20 Oct
keywords: Greece, cost of living, energy crisis, inflation, 2027 budget, fiscal policy, EU fiscal rules, household incomes, energy subsidies, euro area, Bank of Greece, primary surplus, economic growth
notes: Greece's government is presenting a 2027 budget built on strong growth projections and a primary surplus, while simultaneously rolling out emergency energy relief as household inflation accelerates sharply. The gap between resilient national finances and financially exposed citizens is generating political friction at home and raising broader questions in Brussels about how European governments should respond to energy shocks under tightened fiscal rules. The debate has implications well beyond Athens.
